say.speaker: partner
say.text: Look up! The sky outside the Emerald Capital just split open like shattered glass, and the whole hillside is shaking!

say.speaker: tusk
say.text: GRAAAOOHHH!! *The ground quakes as the frightened herd surges forward*

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: By the crown... Those are wild Phanpy, Rhyhorn, Aron, and Rolycoly from the foothills, stampeding in a blind panic. Something came out of that Rift and drove them here!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: That ancient behemoth is herding them like a storm! If the stampede breaks past us, it will crash straight through the capital gates. Stand firm and bring down the Great Tusk!
